facts.value: The University Computer Center (HRZ) provides students with the necessary IT for their studies (Goethe Card, HRZ account, student email address, etc.). It also offers advice and support for technical problems.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The telephone hotline of Goethe University helps with questions regarding applications, semester dates, re-registration, change of subjects, double degree, leave of absence, and exmatriculation, etc.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The International Student Services provide international students with information on topics such as residence permits, German courses, financing, studying successfully, careers, and much more. They also offer advice and support.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Student Services support students in social and economic matters, ensuring that students have the necessary infrastructure to study successfully in areas such as educational funding, student housing, cafeterias, and counseling services.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
